note.ja: セル内の非重複ランダム対へ、偶数・奇数粒子数を区別した物理時間のσg衝突確率を適用。エネルギーによる安全上界で事前にsubcycle数を定め、確率clipはしません。壁・流入はflux重み付き分布と実際の残り飛行時間を用います。 開境界のmacro粒子到着数は平均を保つfloor(平均)+Bernoulli(小数部)で分散を下げます。Poisson数揺らぎや熱揺らぎの再現は主張しません。 既存4seedを残して次の8連番seedを追加します。一様順列と安定整数sortは対選択法則を保ちますが、乱数消費と軌道のbit一致は主張しません。
note.en: Disjoint cell-local random pairs with even/odd finite-N physical-time sigma*g acceptance,energy-based safe majorant and predeclared bounded subcycling; no probability caps. Exact flight-to-wall and flux-conditioned diffuse/reservoir velocities with remaining flight time. Open-reservoir macro counts use unbiased floor(mean)+Bernoulli(fraction) per face/species/half-stream to reduce artificial sampling variance; no Poisson number-fluctuation or thermodynamic-fluctuation reproduction claim. Retain the original four seeds and append the next eight consecutive seeds; uniform permutation/stable integer sorting preserves the ideal within-cell matching law,not RNG consumption or bit-identical trajectories.
